options.name: body_replace
options.description: The string that will replace content in the body of HTTP responses..

options.name: name
options.description: The name of  URL Rewriting Rule.

options.name: request_remove_duplicate_cookies
options.description: Only available when 'action_type' is 'http-header-rewrite'. If the system finds multiple items that match your specified cookie name, enabling this option will remove all of them. However, if this option is disabled, only the first matching item will be removed.

options.name: request_remove_duplicate_headers
options.description: Only available when 'action_type' is 'http-header-rewrite'. Enabling this option will remove all multiple items that match your specified header name. However, if this option is disabled, only the first matching item will be removed.

options.name: request_replace_existing_cookies
options.description: Only available when 'action_type' is 'http-header-rewrite'. If there is already a cookie with the same name existing in the request, enabling this option will overwrite the value of the existing cookie with your specified cookie value.

options.name: request_replace_existing_headers
options.description: Only available when 'action_type' is 'http-header-rewrite'. Enable or Disable Replace Existing Headers which overwrites the value of the existing header with your specified header value.  On the other hand, if this option is disabled, the system will insert the header directly without checking if there is an existing header with the same header name.

options.name: response_remove_duplicate_headers
options.description: Only available when 'action_type' is 'http-response-header-rewrite'. Enabling this option will remove all multiple items that match your specified header name. However, if this option is disabled, only the first matching item will be removed.

options.name: response_replace_existing_headers
options.description: Only available when 'action_type' is 'http-response-header-rewrite'. Enable or Disable Replace Existing Headers which overwrites the value of the existing header with your specified header value.  On the other hand, if this option is disabled, the system will insert the header directly without checking if there is an existing header with the same header name.
